speaker: Doctor
text:
The chest X-ray shows fine reticular granulation with a ground-glass appearance in both lungs, which is highly suggestive of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) given the 33-week gestation. Did the baby have a history of delayed or absent breath sounds immediately after delivery, and has the baby required supplemental oxygen?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to surfactant deficiency in a preterm infant.
